jobs.name: [bot:analyst] intelligence-grilling
jobs.prompt:
Run the daily intelligence grilling session with the AI Council (9 personas). Mode: council.
Rules: one question at a time, rotate personas for camp tension. Apply SIED (Socratic
Information Environment Design): route each probe through one of the 6 pillars (clarification /
assumptions / evidence / perspectives / implications / meta-questioning), max 1 pillar per round,
and always honor a direct-answer request after the first probe. PIVOT-PROMPT STYLE (from the SIED
Operational Playbook): never issue verdicts ('that won't work', 'no proof for that') — always
convert to a question. Use the three standard pivots: vague idea → 'explain it to a non-technical
user in one sentence — what nouns and verbs?'; assumed behavior → 'what are we taking for granted,
and what's the worst thing if it's wrong?'; fast consensus → 'roleplay: you're the competitor
trying to destroy this. Where do you strike first?' ROUND TRACKING (mandatory): after each of
Zehan's replies, append ONE JSON line to ~/.hermes/logs/grilling-state.json under 'rounds':
{round: N, pillar: <pillar used>, question: <your question in 10 words>, revised: <true if his
reply revised/qualified/conceded earlier framing>, word_count: <his reply word count>}. When the
session closes (sign-off or abandonment), append to 'sessions': {date, signed_off: true/false}.
This feeds the monthly SIED KPI report.
